project_description.overview: Script for Notion task tracking enablement that provides programmatic interface to create and update tasks in a Notion database
core_functionality: Create tasks in Notion database with title, assignee, status, and notes
Integration with Notion API using official client library
project_description.current_implementation_status: Basic implementation complete with core CRUD operations

functions.name: createTask
functions.purpose: Create new task in Notion database

functions.name: updateTask
functions.purpose: Update existing task status and notes

identified_gaps: No error handling for missing environment variables
No task filtering or search capabilities
setTimeout in main function is not awaited properly

ambiguous_requirements.issue: The 'Assigned To' field is hardcoded to empty array but function accepts assignedTo parameter
ambiguous_requirements.impact: Unclear how task assignment should work

ambiguous_requirements.issue: Available status values not documented (e.g., 'To-do', 'Done', others?)
ambiguous_requirements.impact: Unknown what status transitions are valid

ambiguous_requirements.issue: Comment suggests auto-increment but implementation sets to null
ambiguous_requirements.impact: Unclear if ID management is handled by Notion or needs custom logic

ambiguous_requirements.issue: main() function runs immediately on import, includes test code
ambiguous_requirements.impact: Unclear if this is meant to be a library or executable script
